question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

The woman in the crowd broke down in __hysterics__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Calm**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"hysterics"** means a state of uncontrollable laughter or extreme emotional excitement; it often implies a lack of control. (उन्माद)

 
 
• **Example: **She broke down in** hysterics** when she heard the surprising news.
 
 
 
• **"Calm" **refers to a state of tranquility and peace, where there is no excitement or extreme emotion; it is the opposite of being in hysterics. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the chaos around her, she remained **calm** and composed.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'hysterics' **is **'calm'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aghast **(भौचक्का): Filled with horror or shock.

 
 
• **Example:** He was aghast at the sight of the accident.
 
 
 
• **Cray **(पागल): Informal term for crazy; mentally deranged, especially as manifested in a wild or aggressive way.
 
 
• **Example: **Some of his ideas seemed totally cray to his colleagues.
 
 
 
• **Insanity **(पागलपन): The state of being seriously mentally ill; madness.
 
 
• **Example:** His obsession with the conspiracy theories bordered on insanity.
